headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 10, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 7-1, while the Oakland Athletics secured a narrow 4-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox. The New York Mets continued their winning streak with an 11-1 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, and the Philadelphia Phillies edged the Toronto Blue Jays 7-6. The Boston Red Sox fell short against the Toronto Blue Jays, and the New York Mets took down the Atlanta Braves 8-5.

Several teams have been impacted by injuries, with Tyler Freeman (Colorado Rockies) placed on the 10-day injured list due to lumbar pain, and Nathan Eovaldi (Texas Rangers) placed on the 15-day injured list with right posterior elbow inflammation. Other notable injuries include Devin Williams (New York Mets) with a right shoulder strain, Caleb Kilian (Philadelphia Phillies) with a left oblique strain, and Griffin Jax (Tampa Bay Rays) with right elbow discomfort.

There have been several trades and roster movements, including the Miami Marlins trading Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals, and the Athletics acquiring Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies. The Philadelphia Phillies traded Seth Johnson to the Athletics for Colby Thomas, while the Miami Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for Connor Norby and Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 7-1, handing them a tough loss. Abimelec Ortiz led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Brad Lord pitched 2.2 strong innings for the Reds, striking out 4 batters.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, with a final score of 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with a 3-hit performance.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Pirates 11-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing an 11-1 victory. Sean Manaea led the way on the mound, pitching 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 7-6 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Caleb Kilian earning the win. Kyle Schwarber led the Phillies' offense with two home runs and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays in their latest matchup. Ceddanne Rafaela and Charles McAdoo stood out for the Red Sox in the loss.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves 8-5**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Francisco Lindor and Jared Young leading the charge offensively. Christian Scott was instrumental in the win, contributing to the Mets' success.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Tyler Freeman on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right fielder Tyler Freeman has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to lumbar pain, effective retroactive to August 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' lineup, bringing his skills to the team.
